name: OpenCompass batch accuracy and perplexity
description: Bounded OpenCompass batch profile using AccEvaluator and AveragePPLEvaluator result keys. Accuracy is on the implementation's percentage scale; average_ppl is the arithmetic mean of supplied perplexities, not the separate token-normalized evaluator. This is a source-only component capability profile, not a dataset selection, measured result, model or data permission, contract-validity result or deployment gate. See research/T6-deployment-operations/evaluation.md.
